inclusionQuotes.text: We set out 26 years ago to transform computer graphics. Fueled by the massive growth of the gaming market and its insatiable demand for better 3D graphics , we’ve evolved the GPU into a computer brain at the intersection of virtual reality , high performance computing, and artificial intelligence . NVIDIA GPU computing has become the essential tool of the da Vincis and Einsteins of our time. For t
inclusionQuotes.heading: SUPERCHARGED COMPUTING FOR THE DA VINCIS AND EINSTEINS OF OUR TIME

inclusionQuotes.text: Our invention of the GPU in 1999 made real-time programmable shading possible, giving artists an infinite palette for expression. In 2018, the introduction of the Turing architecture and NVIDIA RTX ™ ray-tracing technology fulfilled another vision of computer scientists, paving the way to new levels of art and realism in real-time graphics. We’ve led the field of visual computing for decades.
inclusionQuotes.heading: NVIDIA REINVENTS MODERN COMPUTER GRAPHICS

inclusionQuotes.text: In 2012, GPU-accelerated AlexNet ushered in the era of superhuman image recognition. Since then, we’ve used deep learning to teach AI how to observe and identify images and sounds, to understand their condition, and to infer what may come next. With the latest breakthroughs in natural language understanding, AI is learning the code of human knowledge. Computers can have natural dialogue, read and
inclusionQuotes.heading: TWO GIANT WAVES OF AI

inclusionQuotes.text: AI is spilling out of the cloud and into the edge where oceans of raw data are generated by the world’s largest industries. On factory floors. In stores. On city streets. In urgent care facilities. The NVIDIA EGX platform puts AI performance closer to the data to drive real-time decisions when and where they’re needed most.
inclusionQuotes.heading: POWERING AI AT THE EDGE

inclusionQuotes.text: AI breakthroughs no longer come from scientific labs and hyperscale cloud providers alone. Self-driving cars, automated farm equipment, and autonomous factory robots have moved quickly from ideas to reality. And it’s only the beginning. The fourth industrial revolution has begun.
inclusionQuotes.heading: EVERYTHING THAT MOVES WILL BE AUTONOMOUS

inclusionQuotes.text: “NVIDIA is reshaping the future of computing. We’ve built a culture where people can do their life's work. We are a learning machine. The mission is boss. Everyone has a voice.” — Jensen Huang
inclusionQuotes.heading: Like No Place You’ve Ever Worked

inclusionQuotes.text: Omniverse, our platform for industrial digitalization, enables industries grounded in physical processes to become software-defined and connect large, highly skilled teams.
inclusionQuotes.heading: Connecting Our Physical and Digital Worlds

inclusionQuotes.text: NVIDIA engineers the most advanced chips, systems, and software for the AI factories of the future. We build new AI services that help companies create their own AI factories.
inclusionQuotes.heading: NVIDIA is the Engine of AI

inclusionQuotes.text: NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to tackle challenges no one else can solve. Our work in AI and digital twins is transforming the world's largest industries and profoundly impacting society.
inclusionQuotes.heading: Our Body of Work

inclusionQuotes.text: Data centers are already about 1-2% of global electricity consumption and growing. This is not sustainable for operating budgets and our planet. Acceleration is the best way to reclaim power and achieve sustainability and net zero.
inclusionQuotes.heading: Accelerated Computing Is Sustainable Computing
